module.purpose: Implements the useQueries React hook for running multiple TanStack Query queries in parallel with combined results, suspense, and error boundary integration.
module.summary: This file exports the useQueries hook which accepts an array of query options, defaulting them via the query client, creating a QueriesObserver to track multiple queries, and returning either combined or individual results. It handles optimistic results, suspense by throwing promises, error boundary reset, and subscription through useSyncExternalStore. The file also contains extensive conditional type utilities that infer and enforce the shapes of the queries array and their corresponding results, with a depth limit to avoid TypeScript recursion errors.
module.businessContext: Part of TanStack Query React adapter. Enables UI to fetch multiple independent data sources together. Failure breaks batch querying and combined result rendering.
functions: useQueries (~L207-328): React hook running multiple queries and returning combined results with suspense support

mutationOfArg: Mutates defaultedOptions._optimisticResults on each query options object (line 235-237)

type UseQueryOptionsForUseQueries<
  TQueryFnData = unknown,
  TError = DefaultError,
  TData = TQueryFnData,
  TQueryKey extends QueryKey = QueryKey,
> = OmitKeyof<
  UseQueryOptions<TQueryFnData, TError, TData, TQueryKey>,
  'placeholderData' | 'subscribed'
> & {
  placeholderData?: TQueryFnData | QueriesPlaceholderDataFunction<TQueryFnData>
}

typeShapes.name: GetUseQueryOptionsForUseQueries
typeShapes.shape:
type GetUseQueryOptionsForUseQueries<T> =
  T extends {
    queryFnData: infer TQueryFnData
    error?: infer TError
    data: infer TData
  }
    ? UseQueryOptionsForUseQueries<TQueryFnData, TError, TData>
    : T extends { queryFnData: infer TQueryFnData; error?: infer TError }
      ? UseQueryOptionsForUseQueries<TQueryFnData, TError>
      : T extends { data: infer TData; error?: infer TError }
        ? UseQueryOptionsForUseQueries<unknown, TError, TData>
        : T extends [infer TQueryFnData, infer TError, infer TData]
          ? UseQueryOptionsForUseQueries<TQueryFnData, TError, TData>
          : T extends [infer TQueryFnData, infer TError]
            ? UseQueryOptionsForUseQueries<TQueryFnData, TError>
            : T extends [infer TQueryFnData]
              ? UseQueryOptionsForUseQueries<TQueryFnData>
              : T extends {
                  queryFn?:
                    | QueryFunction<infer TQueryFnData, infer TQueryKey>
                    | SkipTokenForUseQueries
                  select?: (data: any) => infer TData
                  throwOnError?: ThrowOnError<any, infer TError, any, any>
                }
                ? UseQueryOptionsForUseQueries<
                    TQueryFnData,
                    unknown extends TError ? DefaultError : TError,
                    unknown extends TData ? TQueryFnData : TData,
                    TQueryKey
                  >
                : UseQueryOptionsForUseQueries

  initialData?: infer TInitialData
}
  ? unknown extends TInitialData
    ? UseQueryResult<TData, TError>
    : TInitialData extends TData
      ? DefinedUseQueryResult<TData, TError>
      : TInitialData extends () => infer TInitialDataResult
        ? unknown extends TInitialDataResult
          ? UseQueryResult<TData, TError>

            ? DefinedUseQueryResult<TData, TError>
